英文即时消息: Hi [Name], thanks for reaching out! How can I help you today?
中文对照: 你好 [Name]，感谢联系！今天有什么可以帮你？

英文即时消息: We're online Monday to Friday, 9am–6pm. I'll get back to you first thing tomorrow.
中文对照: 我们周一到周五 9 点到 18 点在线，明天一早回复你。

英文即时消息: Here is our latest catalog: [Catalog link]. Let me know which items you like!
中文对照: 这是最新目录：[Catalog link]，看中哪款告诉我！

英文即时消息: Your sample is on its way. Tracking number: [Tracking number].
Please find the quote for [Quantity] pcs attached. It's valid until [Date].
中文对照: [Quantity] 件的报价单在附件里，有效期到 [Date]。

英文即时消息: We accept bank transfer and PayPal. Once payment is in, we ship within 2 days.
中文对照: 支持银行转账和 PayPal，收款后 2 天内发货。

英文即时消息: Thanks for your order [Order number]! I'll send you an update when it ships.
中文对照: 感谢下单 [Order number]！发货后我会通知你。

英文即时消息: Could you send your logo file and the colour you'd like? We'll make a mockup first.
中文对照: 请发一下 Logo 文件和想要的颜色，我们先出效果图。

英文即时消息: Quick update: your order is in production and on track for [Date].
中文对照: 进度更新：订单正在生产，预计 [Date] 完成。

英文即时消息: Hi [Name], just checking in. Did you have a chance to look at the quote?
中文对照: 你好 [Name]，想跟进一下，报价单看过了吗？

英文即时消息: Hi [Name]! Your order should have arrived. Is everything as expected?
中文对照: 你好 [Name]！订单应该到了，一切都还满意吗？

英文即时消息: Happy holidays, [Name]! Thank you for working with us this year.
中文对照: [Name]，节日快乐！感谢这一年的合作。

英文即时消息: Your parcel has shipped with [Carrier]. Tracking number: [Tracking number].
中文对照: 包裹已由 [Carrier] 发出，单号：[Tracking number]。

英文即时消息: Sorry for the wait. I've contacted [Carrier] and will update you as soon as I hear back.
中文对照: 抱歉久等，我已联系 [Carrier]，有消息马上告诉你。

英文即时消息: No problem. Please send the item back to [Return address] and we'll refund within 3 days.
中文对照: 没问题，请寄回 [Return address]，收到后 3 天内退款。

英文即时消息: So sorry about that! Could you send a photo? We'll send a replacement right away.
中文对照: 非常抱歉！麻烦拍张照片，我们马上补发。
